title: Request Waiver
description: Request a waiver for this policy violation in Sonatype Lifecycle. Submits to the IQ Policy Waiver Request API (status: REQUESTED) after approval by a team lead or admin.

reason.title: Reason for waiver
reason.description: Why should this violation be waived? Recorded as the waiver comment in Lifecycle.

matcher_strategy.title: Waiver Scope (matcher strategy)
matcher_strategy.description: EXACT_COMPONENT waives only this exact component version. ALL_VERSIONS waives every version of this component. ALL_COMPONENTS waives any component that violates this policy.

note_to_reviewer.title: Note to reviewer
note_to_reviewer.description: Optional note giving the approver more context.
